mapper.sql: id, event_id, order_id, event_type, payload, due_time, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, lease_owner, lease_until, attempt_version, last_error, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oms_order_message (event_id, order_id, event_type, payload, due_time, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, lease_owner, lease_until, attempt_version, last_error, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{orderId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, #{dueTime}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{leaseOwner}, #{leaseUntil}, #{attemptVersion}, #{lastError}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM oms_order_message WHERE status = 'FAILED' ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE oms_order_message SET status = 'SENDING', lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, attempt_version = attempt_version + 1, last_error = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt_version = #{version} AND due_time <= #{now} AND ( (status = 'PENDING' AND next_retry_time <= #{now}) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= #{now}) )

UPDATE oms_order_message SET status = 'SENT', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'SENDING' AND attempt_version = #{version}

UPDATE oms_order_message SET status = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetry} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = #{error}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'SENDING' AND attempt_version = #{version}

UPDATE oms_order_message m JOIN oms_order o ON o.id = m.order_id SET m.status = 'PENDING', m.due_time = o.expire_time, m.next_retry_time = o.expire_time, m.lease_owner = NULL, m.lease_until = NULL, m.last_error = 'EARLY_DELIVERY_RESCHEDULED', m.updated_at = NOW() WHERE m.event_id = #{eventId} AND m.status IN ('SENT', 'SENDING') AND o.expire_time IS NOT NULL

UPDATE oms_order_message SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'FAILED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oms_order_consume_failure (event_id, order_id, raw_payload, reason, retry_count, handle_status, created_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{orderId}, #{rawPayload}, #{reason}, #{retryCount}, 0, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oms_order_consume_failure WHERE event_id = #{eventId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oms_order_message WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS pending_messages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oms_order_message WHERE status = 'SENDING') AS sending_messages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oms_order_message WHERE status = 'SENT') AS sent_messages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oms_order_message WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed_messages, (SELECT COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(created_at), NOW()), 0) FROM oms_order_message WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')) AS oldest_pending_seconds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oms_order_consume_failure WHERE handle_status = 0) AS consume_failures, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oms_order WHERE status = 0 AND delete_status = 0 AND expire_time IS NOT NULL AND expire_time <= NOW()) AS expired_uncancelled, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oms_order WHERE status = 0 AND delete_status = 0 AND expire_time IS NULL) AS pending_without_expire_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oms_order_expire_backfill_exception WHERE handle_status = 0) AS backfill_exceptions
